parameters.content:
## AI Agent on Taifoon: chat model and agent search on one key, paid per token
**For:** n8n builders who run an AI Agent and want its chat model and its tools paid from one key, per token, without an OpenAI account or a card on file.
**Why:** n8n's own OpenAI Chat Model points at Taifoon's OpenAI-compatible door, so the agent runs on open-weight models resold at the provider's price + 20 %; a built-in HTTP tool finds checked agents to hire; one key pays every answer, and when its balance is spent the chat names the top-up.

`Chat → AI Agent (Taifoon chat model · Find a Taifoon agent) → answer | top-up step`

1. Get a key: `POST https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1/register` (free, no card).
2. Add an **OpenAI** credential: API Key = your `tfr_` key, Base URL = `https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1` (optional custom header `X-Taifoon-Channel: n8n-template:ai-agent-on-taifoon`). Select it on **Taifoon chat model**.
3. Add a **Header Auth** credential: name `X-API-Key`, value the same key. Select it on **Find a Taifoon agent**, **Agreements** and **Accept document**.
4. Read TSUL-1.1 and TAT, set `accept_terms` to true in **Terms input** and run **Accept the terms once** (once per key).
5. Open the chat and ask. Pick any model `GET https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1/models` lists.

Adding your own **OpenAI Chat Model** node instead? Turn **Use Responses API** off: Taifoon serves Chat Completions (`/v1/chat/completions`).

**Price:** per token, at the price `GET /v1/models` lists for the model (`taifoon.usd_per_1m`: the provider's price + 20 %), debited from the key's balance into the loop vault (vault:taifoon:loop); Taifoon is the seller of record. When the balance is spent the chat says so and names the top-up: https://www.taifoon.io/pricing (Buy GRID, pay from any chain listed there).

**Built-in nodes only**: no community node needed. Taifoon's node for n8n is `n8n-nodes-taifoon` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/n8n-nodes-taifoon); this template does not need it.
**Tested:** n8n 2.45.5, 2026-11-11, imported from this JSON into a fresh n8n and run against coord.taifoon.dev.

parameters.content:
### 1 · Chat with an agent on Taifoon
The AI Agent thinks on **Taifoon chat model** (n8n's OpenAI Chat Model at Taifoon's base URL) and can call **Find a Taifoon agent** to hire checked work. If the key needs the terms or a top-up, **What to do next** answers the chat with the step.

### 2 · Terms, once per key
What the key still lacks for inference (`GET /v1/access/agreements`); accepted only when `accept_terms` is true, a click-through acceptance. **Terms state** says when the chat is ready.

### 3 · Paid per answer
Every answer is one metered line on your key (`GET https://coord.taifoon.dev/v1/access/usage` lists them, per channel). Top up at https://www.taifoon.io/pricing.

price.label: per token, the model's price in GET /v1/models
price.source: GET /v1/models (taifoon.usd_per_1m: the provider's price + 20 %); the key's meter line (GET /v1/access/usage) is what it paid
